item.title: 30-Minute Job Search System ⏲️ • Set a specific job search goal for each session. • Use: “I applied to 5 roles matching my skills today.” • Prioritize tasks: networking, applications, follow-ups. • Track progress in a simple spreadsheet. • Reflect weekly to refine your strategy. How can you refine your daily job search routine for better results? #jobsearch #productivity #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
